answer: Each jury seat is hashed into a bucket by hosting network so a quorum cannot form inside one provider, and every unverified claim in an identity's record cuts its weight before the next round. Because that weight decays while the agent idles, a farm has to keep paying rent to stay visible. The trade-off is slower settlement at the wharf, where a real shipment waits for a prism of opinions from a nebula of operators, but a thousand empty identities never outvote one working one.
